The test image is a near-perfect match with the **Cutting_Weevil** reference collage. Key observations:

- **Test image**: A mango shoot with only tiny triangular leaf remnants at each node — the young leaves have been stripped/eaten away, leaving bare petiole stubs against a light blue sky background.
- **Cutting_Weevil reference**: Identical presentation — stripped shoots with small fragments of curled/crumpled brown leaf tissue at the nodes, same sky-blue background, same camera angle.
- **All other classes** show very different symptoms: Gall_Midge has gall bumps on intact leaves, Anthracnose shows partial leaf damage, Sooty_Mould/Powdery_Mildew show surface coatings, Die_Back shows fully curled brown leaves.

The stripped shoot with only small remnants of young leaves is the classic signature of Cutting_Weevil damage.
